title: 내모남불 ⑥ 아파트편 · 층간소음 · 주차 두 칸 · 택배 박스

lines.en: Thumping again?! Report them! Report them!

lines.text: 운동은 밤에 해야 살이 빠지지~ 모 어때!
lines.en: Workouts burn more at night~ So what!
lines.style: out of breath, jogging on a treadmill, cheerfully humming

lines.tts: 밤 열 시부터는, 기준이 더 엄격합니다.
lines.en: After 10 p.m., the standard is stricter.
Sir, when did you get in here?!
Management office.

lines.text: 남이 뛰면 신고, 내가 뛰면 운동. 내모남불, 하나.
lines.en: They stomp: report them. I stomp: a workout. Double standard, number one.
I'm… Modapman.

lines.tts: 사건 개요. 밤 열한 시 사 분, 십이 층.
lines.en: Case summary. 11:04 p.m., 12th floor.
Dad, what's floor noise?

lines.text: 윗집이 우리 머리 위에서 볼링 치는 거.
lines.en: When upstairs bowls on top of our heads.

lines.tts: 딱 세 판만 하죠. 일 라운드, 층간소음.
lines.en: Just three rounds. Round one: floor noise.
Tonight again… the suspect swung the heel hammer.
lines.style: hard-boiled noir detective monologue, low and dramatic

lines.en: What's a heel hammer?

lines.text: 뒤꿈치로 쿵쿵 걷는 거. 아빠 건 생활 소음이고.
lines.en: Stomping on your heels. Mine's just everyday living noise.

lines.text: '혹시 집에서 볼링 치십니까?' 크크… 문장력 봐.
lines.en: "Do you, perhaps, bowl at home?" Heh heh… what a writer.
lines.style: giggling to himself, a nerdy wheezy snicker

lines.en: Let me share the template in the building group chat. Help yourselves~

lines.text: 남이 걸으면 발망치, 내가 걸으면 생활 소음. 내모남불, 둘.
lines.en: They walk: a heel hammer. I walk: everyday noise. Double standard, number two.
Tonight, I'm telling them.
lines.style: heroic, determined, like a movie hero

lines.text: 아이고, 아랫집 아빠구나. 귤 좀 가져가.
lines.en: Oh my, it's the dad from downstairs. Take some tangerines.
Oh… yes… tangerines… thank you… looks delicious…
lines.style: shrinking, tiny timid voice, all courage gone

lines.en: Dad, what about the letter?
…It's a thank-you letter.
Rather than going up yourself, tell the management office first.
When did you get here?!
Management office.

lines.text: 뛰는 소리, 걷는 소리, 다 층간소음입니다. 밤엔 더 엄격하고요.
lines.en: Running, walking, it's all floor noise. And it's stricter at night.

lines.text: 내 소리는 내가 끌 수 있어서, 덜 거슬립니다.
lines.en: Your own noise bothers you less, because you can stop it.
Round two: parking across two spaces.

lines.text: 두 칸 주차? 양심 어디 갔어. 찰칵!
lines.en: Two spaces? Where's your conscience? Click!
The Justice Neighbor strikes again~
But your car's in two spaces too.

lines.text: 아빠는 문콕 무서워서 그래. 다들 이렇게 대잖아~ 모 어때.
lines.en: I'm scared of door dings. Everyone parks like this~ So what.
…Who took this?!

lines.text: 남이 대면 박제, 내가 대면 문콕 예방. 내모남불, 셋.
lines.en: They do it: posted online. I do it: preventing door dings. Double standard, number three.

lines.text: 문콕이 무서우시면, 한 칸 안에 반듯이 대시면 됩니다.
lines.en: If you're scared of door dings, park straight inside one space.

lines.text: 다들 이렇게 한다고 믿는 거, 허위 합의 효과입니다.
lines.en: Believing everyone does it too is called the false consensus effect.
False… what?
Round three: delivery boxes.

lines.text: 테이프도 안 떼고! 양심을 같이 버렸네.
lines.en: Tape still on! They threw out their conscience too.

lines.text: 이건 박스 탑이야. 아파트 예술 작품이지~
lines.en: This is a box tower. Apartment art~

lines.text: 여보, 거기 당신 이름 대문짝만 하게 있어.
lines.en: Honey, your name is on there in giant letters.
Heh heh… it's… an autograph session.
lines.style: awkward nerdy snicker, covering the label with his hand

lines.text: 남이 버리면 양심 불량, 내가 버리면 예술. 내모남불, 넷.
lines.en: They do it: no conscience. I do it: art. Double standard, number four.

lines.text: 택배 상자는 테이프랑 송장 떼고, 접어서 종이로.
lines.en: Delivery boxes: peel off the tape and the label, fold, then paper bin.
You came out of THERE…?!
Management office.
Bonus round. Rapid-fire double standards!

lines.text: 남이 복도에 두면 통행 방해, 내가 두면 잠깐 둔 거!
lines.en: Their stuff in the hallway: blocking. Mine: just for a sec!

lines.text: 남이 구우면 냄새 테러, 내가 구우면 행복한 냄새!
lines.en: Their grilling: a smell attack. Mine: the smell of happiness!

lines.text: 남이 박으면 공사, 내가 박으면 액자 하나!
lines.en: Their hammering: construction. Mine: one little picture frame!
Double standard: five, six, seven!

lines.text: 아빠, 우리 집 천장은 윗집 바닥이지?
lines.en: Dad, our ceiling is upstairs' floor, right?
Right.

lines.text: 그럼 우리 집 바닥은, 아랫집 천장이야.
lines.en: Then our floor is downstairs' ceiling.
…Let's bring tangerines downstairs tomorrow.
Here. Read this.
"Do you, perhaps, bowl at home?" …How RUDE!

lines.text: 여보… 그거 당신이 단톡방에 올린 양식이잖아.
lines.en: Honey… that's the template YOU posted in the group chat.
…Lovely writing, sir.

lines.text: 남이 쓰면 무례, 내가 쓰면 명문. 내모남불, 여덟.
lines.en: They write it: rude. I write it: a masterpiece. Double standard, number eight.

lines.tts: 천이백삼 호, 본인 편지 반송 완료.
lines.en: Unit 1203, your own letter has been returned to sender.

lines.text: 그 편지는, 아빠가 쓴 것이었습니다. 그냥 오답.
lines.en: That letter was written by Dad himself. Just a wrong answer.
…Classic Modapman.
